title: Italian Frittata with Eggs
description: A light and nourishing Italian-inspired frittata, perfect for any meal. This recipe features eggs as the main ingredient, combined with a blend of flavors and textures.

ingredients.name: light
ingredients.notes: grated light cheese, such as mozzarella or parmesan

ingredients.name: rusian
ingredients.notes: diced russian sausage, such as kielbasa

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt.
Add the grated light cheese and diced russian sausage to the bowl.
Stir in the chopped nourishing and season with pepper.
Heat a 9-inch (23cm) oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Add the egg mixture to the skillet and cook until the edges start to set.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the frittata is set and golden brown.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Use a spatula to loosen the frittata from the skillet and slide it onto a plate.
Slice the frittata into wedges and serve hot.
Garnish with additional chopped nourishing, if desired.
